concepts.name: 01-camera
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. One original iOS document scanner app icon concept. Camera MUST be the unmistakable dominant subject, recognizable instantly at 32px. Premium simple 2D FLAT vector-like geometry, friendly softly rounded forms, crisp edges. Strict flat solid colors: cobalt blue #145FE8, mint #09BFA5, white. Square full-bleed opaque canvas, no rounded outer canvas corners. Mark occupies 65 percent, centered with generous safe margins. No text, letters, watermark, gradients, shadows, texture, 3D, photorealism, mockup or collage. Solid cobalt blue background. A bold white front-facing camera silhouette with rounded rectangular body and a distinct raised viewfinder bump on top. One large mint circular lens with a cobalt circular center, and one tiny cobalt flash mark. The body is broad and substantial, the lens is the main focal point. Pure iconic camera, no document, no scanner brackets.
